description:
List messages for one number, newest first, received and sent.

Each item says who it is from and to, which number it belongs to, its
`direction`, `content_type`, `origin`, a short `preview`, `at`, `status`
and `content_expired`. Mentions, transcription and full media detail
are only on `get_message`, so fetch the one message you care about
rather than paging for detail.

To read a group, find its `grp_` id with `list_groups` and pass it as
`group_id`. `contact_id` returns what that contact sent or received,
which in a group includes what they said there. `direction` keeps only
`inbound` or `outbound`. Filters combine: `group_id` with `contact_id`
answers what one person said in one group.

Ids belong to one number, so use the same `number_alias` you got them
from: an id from another number answers not found. For the next page,
pass back the `cursor` from the previous response together with the
same filters.

Content older than the plan's retention window comes back with
`preview` empty and `content_expired` true. The message, its sender and
its group stay listed for 12 months.

contact_id.description: Only the messages this contact sent or received (`ct_…`, from `list_contacts`). In a group that includes what the contact said there. The contact must be one of this number's: an id from another number answers not found. With `group_id` too, you get what that contact said in that group.
contact_id.title: Contact Id

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Pass back the `cursor` from the previous response, with the same filters; omit it for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

direction.description: Only messages the number received (`inbound`) or sent (`outbound`). Absent means both.
direction.title: Direction

group_id.description: Only the messages of one group (`grp_…`, from `list_groups`). The group must be one of this number's: an id from another number answers not found. Can be combined with `contact_id`.
group_id.title: Group Id

limit.description: How many items to return, 1-200. Defaults to 50.
limit.title: Limit

number_alias.description: Which of the organization's WhatsApp numbers this acts on: `main`, the alias of an extra number, or the number's `id` (`num_…`), which stays the same when the alias is renamed. Call `list_numbers` to see them. Defaults to the main number.
number_alias.title: Number Alias

name: list_messages
title: List messages in an inbox
